resources.string: Blocks selected headset, media, call, assistant, and external volume key events while Android delivers them to Accessibility. It does not read screen contents or typed text.

Hybrid blocking: Shizuku handles media keys and a selected headset input device while Accessibility remains available for screen-on filtering. The phone’s own volume buttons remain untouched. No USB interface claiming.
Keep Shizuku running. Reopen this app after Shizuku or the phone restarts.

Media buttons are consumed before normal media sessions. For headset volume buttons, scan and select the headset’s own input device. The volume guard restores media volume after events from only that device; it does not intercept the phone’s side buttons.
Neutralize volume presses from selected headset

Choose the USB/IEM/headset device, not gpio-keys or another entry marked as likely phone buttons. The guard is read-only and may briefly show the volume overlay while restoring the previous media volume.
No volume-key input devices found. Connect the headset, keep Shizuku running, then scan again.
Android 13+: if the Accessibility switch is greyed out, open App info, tap the top-right menu, and choose “Allow restricted settings”.
